title: Coconut White Chocolate Brownies
changes_from_base: Chewy brown sugar bar (no dark chocolate) with white chocolate, cranberries and toasted coconut.
summary: Chewy brown sugar bars with white chocolate, dried cranberries and toasted coconut.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: half for the batter, half for the top

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and grease and line the large tin.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the melted butter and brown sugar until smooth, beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla and salt.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Whisk the flour with the baking powder, stir it into the butter mixture, then fold in the white chocolate, cranberries and half the coconut.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin, scatter the rest of the coconut over and bake 25-30 min, until golden and a skewer comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool fully in the tin before cutting into 24.

tips: Use unsweetened desiccated coconut so the bars are not too sweet.
Swap the cranberries for chopped dried apricots if you like.
Do not overbake; they should stay chewy.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
